name: independent-repair-anchor
purpose: Evidence repair: re-establishes a claim an earlier record recorded unreliably. Every step asserts and throws if its outcome is not observed.

steps.action: A templated Matter anchors every relative date on its own UTC creation date
steps.actual: Matter 33 was created between 2026-09-08T06:33:42.065Z and 2026-09-08T06:33:42.194Z with createdAt 2026-09-08T06:33:42.112Z, so its UTC civil anchor is 2026-09-08. Every template Task resolved against that anchor: [["Confirm scope with the requester (revised)",3,"2026-09-11","Nadia Haddad"],["Open the evidence folder (retry probe)",null,null,null]] (title, template offset, resolved due date, assignee) — the Matter Manager Task carries Nadia Haddad and the undated Task stays null. Every template Key date resolved the same way: [["Onboarding review point",21,"2026-09-29"]]. The Matter took the template's Priority "high", Risk "medium" and Field defaults {"ind_coverage_region_ind81t2f":"Benelux"}, and the creation dialog had seeded Priority "high" and Risk "medium" from the same template. Each of these is an assertion: a mismatch throws.
